 6 more die of dengue
 Death toll rises to 439 as total cases reach 1,40,909 
 Published : 3 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 3 November 2026, 18:06
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least six dengue patients died and 2,010 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, five were reported in Dhaka division and one in Barishal division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the death toll rose to 439, while the cumulative number of cases reached 1,40,909.
 Currently, 5,876 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
